top.line: Lovable's agent can change production; its controls are real, its defaults open, and the policy records what each project's agent may do.
top.para: From Lovable's docs: Build mode applies changes directly, the agent can change the live database, auth and connected systems, and publish. Controls include per-action permissions, Plan mode, migration approval, scans, publish blocks, workspace policies, a pre-prompt hook and audit logs, and Lovable holds AIUC-1. Nine of ten backend permissions default to Always allow, set per user. The policy sets which go to Ask each time, per project.

in-short.line: Production reach, real controls, open defaults, a platform certificate, the policy per project.
in-short.para: Six points; nothing run on Lovable yet.

why.line: A builder for non-engineers, which makes defaults matter more.
why.para: Raised $400 million at a $13.3 billion valuation in August; two earlier newsroom pieces.

reach.line: Three modes, long goals, Lovable Cloud on the live database, connectors, secrets, testing and publishing.
reach.para: Shared connectors mirror the connected account.

defaults.line: Nine of ten backend permissions default to Always allow, including changing data and auth.
defaults.para: Breaking migrations default to Never; settings are per user across every workspace.

controls.line: Plan mode, connector approvals, scans, publish block, workspace policies, secrets, hook and audit logs, each with its gap.
controls.para: The publish block is off by default outside Enterprise; the hook and logs see prompts, not actions.

aiuc.line: AIUC-1 covers the platform; the project still needs its own record.
aiuc.para: Lovable's April 2026 incident and two-hour fix show both levels are needed.

layers.line: Read, set, gate, attest on Lovable.
layers.para: Strong pieces on paid tiers; a policy-driven pre-prompt hook is proposed.

offer.line: A policy per project, a settings checklist, a hook from the policy, the policy beside the certificate.

limits.line: Not run on Lovable; beta labels as documented; the incident in Lovable's words.

sources.line: Lovable docs and three blog posts, riskmandate.ai and earlier articles.
